payload.subject: [TradeAgent PAPER] September10 trade not executed - status
payload.text:
No trade was placed today. Your requested paper trade was not completed.

This morning the worker was still in SHADOW mode with a September9 session date and active trading pauses. I had not enabled automatic daily rollover/trading. That was an incomplete handoff, not an Alpaca fill failure or an exhausted September10 budget.

I implemented and deployed the reviewed current-date worker code7431393, including account binding, emergency-control version checks, durable owned-position recovery and conservative historical-risk accounting. The worker remains in SHADOW mode under iex-operator-host-20260910. No order request or certificate was published and no old pause or terminal was cleared.

Its actual 1802.6-second live acceptance finished at15:48ET, with 2352 HTTP requests, zero HTTP errors, no new recorder queue drops/gaps and advancing physical/source data. This was after the existing15:30 entry cutoff. I did not extend that cutoff or force a late order. Review fixes, validation and the interrupted session took too long to execute your request today.

At 2026-09-10T15:49:28.886094-04:00, the paper account was ACTIVE/unblocked, with zero positions, zero open orders, zero unresolved local intents and zero September10 orders. The requested trade is NOT a filled or rejected trade.

Recurring automatic news trading is still NOT enabled. The separate standing-policy/duration/revocation and risk-review decision remains unresolved; this one-off path does not supply indefinite authority. A read-only pre-open readiness check and clear status email are scheduled for09:00ET September11 so this is not left silent until midday. That check will not manufacture approval, clear R1/manual kills or replay today's request.

This is a new once-only final-status notice through the existing Render notifier, not a resend of prior messages. No profitability or qualification claim is made.
